item.description:
Aside 1.7.8

Subscription keys renew themselves, the trial says where you stand, and beta dictation stops fighting your music.

Improved

  • Subscription keys renew automatically. The app refreshes your key in the background before it expires — no more digging the renewal out of your email. A "Refresh now" button in Settings › License shows exactly where you stand.
  • The trial tells you where you are. The idle panel quietly notes how many free meetings are left, and the last-meeting message is accurate even after it passed.

Dictation (beta builds)

  • Your music pauses while you dictate — and comes back when you stop. Aside first checks that something is genuinely playing, so music that was already paused never starts on its own.
  • Steady speech bars. A measurement bug made syllables land at random heights; the meter now reads your voice faithfully and moves the way you would expect.
